[[Moonstride Leggings]] | previous = [[Scales of the Tideblade]] | next = [[Word to the High Priestess]] }} == Objectives == Slay Lady Serpentia and Lord Ta'jax in the ruins of Nendis, then return to Sentinel Commander Silverstreak at Narvalis Point. * [[Lady Serpentia]] slain * [[Lord Ta'jax]] slain == Description == You have proven the naga can bleed. Now we make certain they cannot recover. Two commanders direct the Tideblade forces occupying Nendis. Veterans from the day Illidan’s armies burned the town to the ground. Lady Serpentia. Lord Ta'jax. They served as lieutenants during the assault. It was their warbands that swept through the streets while the town burned. They have ruled the ruins ever since. If the Tideblade are to lose their hold here, those two must fall. Without their leadership the naga will fracture into smaller broods, easier to drive back into the sea. The naga have ruled those ruins long enough. ==Rewards== * 5700 [[XP]] == Progress == Do not underestimate them. These two commanded armies during Illidan’s campaign. They survived battles that slaughtered hundreds. Creatures like that do not fall easily. == Completion == Lady Serpentia… and Ta'jax as well. Good. Very good. Without them, the Tideblade will splinter into rival broods. Naga are not known for unity when strong leaders are absent. That gives us the advantage. The ruins of Nendis may finally know peace again. The High Priestess should hear of it. ==Progression== #{{questlong|Alliance|54|Scales of the Tideblade}} #{{questlong|Alliance|56|Serpents Without Heads}} #{{questlong|Alliance|56|Word to the High Priestess}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.1|note=Added.}}
